items.title: Show HN: Why write code if the LLM can just do the thing? (web app experiment)
items.raw_excerpt: I spent a few hours last weekend testing whether AI can replace code by executing directly. Built a contact manager where every HTTP request goes to an LLM with three tools: database (SQLite), webResponse (HTML/JSON/JS), and updateMemory (feedback). No routes, no controllers, no business logic. The AI designs schemas on first request, generates UIs from paths alone, and evolves based on natural language feedback. It works—forms submit, data persists, APIs return JSON—but it's catastrophically slow (30-60s per request), absurdly expensive ($0.05/request), and has zero UI consistency between requests. The capability exists; performance is the problem. When inference gets 10x faster, maybe the question shifts from "how do we generate better code?" to "why generate code at all?"

items.title: RTE2025：从“连接”到“对话”，对话式 AI 驱动 RTE 产业跃迁之路

excerpt_i18n.en: On October 31, the 11th Real-Time Internet Conference, Convo AI & RTE 2025, jointly organized by Agora and the RTE Developer Community, officially opened in Beijing. Themed "AI with Sound," the event brought together top global RTE and conversational AI experts, developers, corporate representatives, and ecosystem partners to explore new scenarios, architectures, and opportunities in the deep integration of real-time engagement (RTE) and conversational AI (Convo AI). At the main forum, keynote speeches and panel discussions were delivered by guests including Zhao Bin, founder and CEO of Agora; Wei Qing, CTO of Microsoft China; and Tony Wang, co-founder of Agora. Zhao Bin announced that Agora's annual service minutes exceeded one trillion for the first time, highlighting RTE technology as an essential infrastructure. He also noted that conversational AI will become a key part of the next-generation AI infrastructure. Additionally, the proportion of high-definition video has increased over tenfold in the past two years, with overseas markets seeing more than 720p resolution traffic accounting for a significant share.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 31 de octubre, se inauguró oficialmente en Pekín la undécima Conferencia de Internet en Tiempo Real Convo AI & RTE 2025, organizada conjuntamente por Agora y la comunidad de desarrolladores RTE.
